text: Yes, the tree cover on this asset has remained unchanged since 2020. The analysis found no detectable tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger within the asset between 2021 and 2025. The data sources used (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) confirm that the tree cover observed in 2020 persisted through 2025. However, note that changes smaller than 0.5 hectares or at the edges may not be captured due to the 30-meter pixel resolution.
